veranderings.rede: One does not 'fix' smoke in Afrikaans; 'keer' (stop, prevent) is the natural verb and is shorter.

veranderings.blok: Dinge wat jy elke dag kan doen
veranderings.rede: 'blik' alone reads as a tin can, and the list uses 'ou blikke' for tins two lines later; 'vullisblik' is unambiguous and matches the last item.

veranderings.blok: Dinge wat jy elke dag kan doen
veranderings.rede: AWS 2017: a comma before 'want' joining two main clauses, here an imperative and 'die rook trek'.
The passive 'is ... 'n hele week gemaak' is stiff; 'het later 'n hele week geword' says the same thing naturally in the same number of words.

veranderings.na: wat deur bome en plante opgeneem word
veranderings.rede: 'wat bome en plante opneem' can be read as the gas taking up the trees; the passive makes clear that the plants take up the gas.
